legacy_reanalysis.labels: Historical local HumanEval verifier, not EvalPlus HumanEval+
limitations: Retrospective design after legacy results were seen
Only final states available; no inference about 32-token prediction
Historical retokenization/extraction lacks the new causal and token-ID validation
Conditional bootstrap of fixed OOF scores, not full procedure retraining
Late baseline lacks token confidence features; not the main B comparison

permutation.null: No within-task score/outcome association in every outer fold
permutation.assumption: Within-task label exchangeability conditional on the held-out fold scorer

H2.conditional_population: Held-out tasks with both correct and incorrect eligible attempts

fixed_effects.interpretation: Complementary inference on OOF scores; not an out-of-sample fitted predictor

signal.interval_scope: Task bootstrap conditional on fitted OOF scorers; overlapping training folds are not refitted

H3.interpretation: Predeclared diagnostic only; no operational benefit claim when H2 is unsupported

policies.wall_clock_savings: Not inferred from token replay; require online timing
policies.accounting: Completion tokens only; prompt-prefill tokens and verification times are separate

main.robustness: Run MBPP+ only after the main pipeline has passed its gates

provenance.advisor_approval: See execution authorization; not inferred from execution

policies.wall_clock_savings: Not inferred from token replay; require online timing
policies.accounting: Completion tokens only; prompt-prefill tokens and verification times are separate

execution_authorization.evidence_scope: Fixed-design prospective execution; legacy exposure disclosed in protocol
execution_authorization.online_task_selection: Lexicographic task IDs, no outcome filtering

supplemental.timing: Requested after completion and inspection of the fixed-design results
limitations: Conditional on fixed fitted scores; models are not refitted during bootstrap or deletions
Pointwise exploratory intervals; no simultaneous coverage or new confirmatory claims
Outer folds share training data and are not independent replications
Common cohort conditions on trajectory length T>64 and is not a causal time comparison
Calibration error depends on binning and sample size; use with proper losses
Percentile ECE bootstrap can be biased upward and need not contain the empirical ECE
Excluding historically generated tasks only changes evaluation; training is not redone
OOF source and full-source-fitted target scorers use different evaluation procedures
Development recall 0.97 is an empirical selection target, not a held-out guarantee

HumanEval+ OOF.denominator: All active correct candidates at the frozen policy checkpoint; no conditioning on replay initiation
HumanEval+ OOF.estimand: Candidate-level recall (ratio of summed counts); tasks are resampled as clusters

MBPP+ frozen.denominator: All active correct candidates at the frozen policy checkpoint; no conditioning on replay initiation
MBPP+ frozen.estimand: Candidate-level recall (ratio of summed counts); tasks are resampled as clusters

decision_ledger.criterion: Online identity replay with actual abort
